description: This is a Dart source file defining the RasaClient class, which serves as a lightweight REST client for interacting with a Rasa chatbot server. It contains methods to send messages and handle responses, utilizing external models for request and response data structures, and reads configuration from environment variables.

classes.name: RasaClient
classes.description: A lightweight REST client for communicating with a Rasa webhook, providing methods for sending messages and handling responses.

methods.name: RasaClient
methods.description: Constructor for RasaClient, initializes HTTP client and webhook URI, optionally using environment variables.
